Hi Team!

This is my second order from helium deploy. I ordered a thor p2 and the
power brick makes a really annoying like screeching noise. I have another
p2 from another company that has a power brick same one and it doesn't make
the noise. I also thought that the device would come with harlo installed.
I wanted to get this device through you guys to try out the HARLO os. This
also happened to my BC04, it doesn't seem to have come with HARLO - that is
ok. Trying out THOR os is fine on the BC04. Please know I have also ordered
the B30! I am pumped.

But the thor P2 power brick is too loud with the screeching noise. it also
didn't come with harlo. The little green back price to hold the cord is
also broken which is not a big deal.

If you can please help me out I would appreciate it!
Javier M.

Hi Javier,

Thanks for the video, and sorry about the power brick. A screeching PSU is not normal, and you should not have to send the whole miner back for it. I have put in a replacement power supply for your Thor P2 on order Shop····, plus the little green cord retainer clip, so both go out together. A colleague picks this up tomorrow at 10am ET and you will get the shipping confirmation by email at this address. One thing I have to ask for the record: has the unit been overclocked at all? That affects warranty cover, so I want to note the answer either way.

On Harlo OS, you did not miss anything and you were not charged for it. The P2 and the BC04 are shipping with stock firmware at the moment, and Harlo OS is a free flash you can do yourself. The downloads, release notes and the install guide for each model are at https://harlolabs.com/ . Grab the newest build listed for the Thor P2 there rather than an older one, since most odd readings people report turn out to be a stale version. If you want someone looking over your shoulder while you flash it, our Discord is the fastest route, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , and JD is very active there as @nullhashrate.

And yes, I can see the B30 on Shop····. That one ships October 30. You can follow the shipment on its way to us at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status .

Happy to help with anything else here.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Sarah,

Thank you for the help with the replacement parts! To answer your question,
the unit has not been overclocked at all. It’s been on the stock “normal”
setting.

Thanks for the info on the Harlo OS as well, I appreciate it.

Javier M. (phone hidden)

Hi Javier,

Great to hear it arrived, and thanks for confirming the P2 was never overclocked. I have noted that on the order, so the unit stays fully covered.

One thing to check when you have a second: the little green cord retainer clip should have been in the same package as the power supply. If it was not in there, just say the word and I will get one sent out to you.

If the new brick is quiet and the miner is hashing happily, you are all set. And the Harlo OS flash is there whenever you feel like trying it, the builds and guides are at https://harlolabs.com/ , and the Discord is the quickest place to get a hand with it, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf .

It was a real pleasure helping you with this one. If you were happy with how it went, a short review on Trustpilot would mean a lot to us, https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com .

Enjoy the P2, and the B30 when it lands.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

I wrote a super positive/excellent review on trust pilot.

Hi Javier,

Thank you for sticking with us, and for the kind words. You have been patient longer than you should have had to be on both of these, and I am sorry.

On the BC04 fan, you are right that there is something wrong. Your fan is turning roughly 950 RPM below an identical unit on the same firmware at the same 100 percent command, and that is not chip variance, that is the fan. I have put it in front of JD this morning asking for one thing specifically, a replacement fan sent out to you rather than more testing. He picks it up today at 10am ET and the answer comes to you here. If you want it faster, JD is on our Discord as @nullhashrate and he is very responsive there, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf .

On the $75 and the booking link, that is still with Abel and Georges and I have pushed it again this morning. It is above what I can issue myself, which is why it has to come from them, but you should hear today.

On the B30, good news there. Yours is in the final 100 units. The factory ships end of November and the unit should be in your hands by mid December, with December 15 the date on your order. Your free Power K. is on it too, and you can follow the shipment on its way to us at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status .

Nothing needed from you for any of it.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
